abstract: Previous sharp oil price declines have been accompanied by elevated ex-post volatility. In contrast, volatility was much less elevated during the oil price crash in 2014/15. We provide evidence that oil prices declined in a relatively measured manner during 2014/15, with a dispersion of price changes that was considerably smaller than comparable oil price declines. This finding is robust to using both descriptive and GARCH measures of volatility. Further, the US dollar appreciation exerted a strong influence on volatility during the recent crash; in contrast, the impact of equity market shocks was muted.
abstract_zh: 以往石油价格的急剧下跌往往伴随着事后波动率的升高。相比之下，2014/15年油价暴跌期间的波动率升高幅度要小得多。我们提供证据表明，2014/15年间石油价格以相对平稳的方式下跌，价格变化的离散程度远小于可比的石油价格下跌。无论使用描述性波动率指标还是GARCH波动率指标，这一发现都是稳健的。此外，美元升值对近期暴跌期间的波动率产生了强烈影响；相比之下，股票市场冲击的影响则较为微弱。

title: What Explains Agricultural Price Movements?
abstract: After 2005, commodity prices experienced their longest and broadest boom since World War II. Agricultural prices have now come down considerably since their 2011 peak, but are still 40 percent higher in real terms than their 2000 lows. This paper briefly addresses the main arguments on the causes of the agricultural price cycle. It broadens the scope of analysis by focusing on six agricultural commodities, and identifies the relative weights of key quantifiable drivers of their prices. It concludes that increases in real income negatively affect real agricultural prices, as predicted by Engel's Law. Energy prices matter most (not surprisingly, given the energy-intensive nature of agriculture), followed by stock-to-use ratios and, to a lesser extent, exchange rate movements. The cost of capital affects prices only marginally, probably because it not only influences demand, but also evokes a supply response.
abstract_zh: 2005年后，大宗商品价格经历了第二次世界大战以来最长、最广泛的一轮繁荣。农产品价格自2011年峰值以来已大幅回落，但按实际价格计算，仍比2000年的低点高出40%。本文简要讨论了农产品价格周期成因的主要论点。本文将分析范围扩展至六种农产品，并确定了其价格关键可量化驱动因素的相对权重。研究认为，实际收入增长会对实际农产品价格产生负面影响，这与恩格尔定律的预测一致。能源价格影响最大（这并不令人意外，因为农业是能源密集型产业），其次是库存消费比，汇率变动的影响程度较小。资本成本对价格的影响微乎其微，这可能是因为它不仅影响需求，还会引发供给反应。

abstract: This book is a welcome effort to examine the key reasons behind the 2005–2009 food price boom. As the author acknowledges early on, ‘Given the size and complexity of the world food system, the list of forces that determine the price of food is incredibly long. This book is not intended to examine every aspect of the issue, but instead focuses on a few of the most important factors.’ (p. 3). The first seven chapters of the book cover the role of biofuels, energy prices, government policies, weather, income growth and changing diets, $US exchange rate, and speculation. The penultimate chapter focuses on some less known factors, such as animal diseases. The book concludes with some long-term issues. The seven chapters follow a similar pattern. Each begins with a brief overview, followed by the 2005–2009 experience. It then offers the views of various parties (often conflicting), and concludes by discussing the complexity of the issue.
abstract_zh: 本书对2005至2009年食品价格飙升的关键原因进行了探讨，值得欢迎。正如作者在开篇所承认的：“鉴于世界粮食体系的规模和复杂性，决定粮食价格的因素清单极其冗长。本书无意审视这一问题的每一个方面，而是聚焦于少数最重要的因素。”（第3页）。全书前七章涵盖生物燃料、能源价格、政府政策、天气、收入增长与饮食变化、美元汇率以及投机等因素的作用。倒数第二章关注一些较少为人所知的因素，例如动物疾病。全书以若干长期问题作结。这七章遵循相似的结构：每章以简要概述开头，接着叙述2005至2009年的经历，然后介绍各方（常常相互冲突）的观点，最后讨论该问题的复杂性。

title: More on the energy/nonenergy price link
abstract: This note re-examines the energy/nonenergy price link. Using annual data from the period 1960 to 2008, it finds that the pass-through of energy price changes to the overall nonenergy commodity index is 0.28. At a more disaggregated level, the fertilizer index exhibited the largest pass-through (0.55), followed by agriculture (0.26) and metals (0.25).
abstract_zh: 本短文重新考察了能源价格与非能源价格之间的联系。利用1960至2008年的年度数据，研究发现能源价格变动向非能源大宗商品综合指数的传导系数为0.28。在更细的分类层面上，化肥指数的传导系数最大（0.55），其次是农业（0.26）和金属（0.25）。

title: Oil spills on other commodities
abstract: This paper examines the effect of crude oil prices on the prices of 35 internationally traded primary commodities for the 1960-2005 period. It finds that the pass-through of crude oil price changes to the overall non-energy commodity index is 0.16. At a more disaggregated level, the fertilizer index had the highest pass-through (0.33), followed by agriculture (0.17), and metals (0.11). The prices of precious metals also exhibited a strong response to the crude oil price. In terms of individual commodities, the estimates of the food group exhibited remarkable similarity while those of raw materials and metals gave a mixed picture. The implication is that if crude oil prices remain high for some time, as most analysts expect, then the recent commodity price boom is likely to last much longer than earlier booms, at least for food commodities. The other commodities, however, are likely to follow diverging paths. On the methodological side, the results show that price indices, while providing useful summary statistics, need to be supplemented by individual commodity analysis
abstract_zh: 本文考察了1960至2005年间原油价格对35种国际贸易初级商品价格的影响。研究发现，原油价格变动向非能源大宗商品综合指数的传导系数为0.16。在更细的分类层面上，化肥指数的传导系数最高（0.33），其次是农业（0.17）和金属（0.11）。贵金属价格对原油价格也表现出强烈反应。就单个商品而言，食品类的估计结果表现出惊人的一致性，而原材料和金属类的结果则较为复杂。这意味着，如果原油价格如多数分析师所预期的那样长期保持高位，那么近期的大宗商品价格繁荣很可能比以往的繁荣持续时间更长，至少对食品类商品而言是如此。然而，其他商品可能会走上不同的路径。在方法论方面，研究结果表明，价格指数虽然能提供有用的汇总统计量，但需要以单个商品的分析加以补充。

Disciplining agricultural support through decoupling
venue: World Bank Policy Research Working Paper
abstract: Agricultural protection, particularly in high income countries, have induced overproduction, thereby depressing world commodity prices and reducing export shares of countries which do not support agriculture. One-and perhaps the only-effective way to bring a socially acceptable and politically feasible reform is to replace payments linked to current production levels, input use, and prices by payments which are decoupled from these measures. Overall, the experience with decoupling agricultural support has been mixed while the switch to less distortive support has been uneven across commodities and countries. Rules have changed with new decoupling programs added so expectations about future policies affect current production decisions. Time limits were not implemented and if so, were overruled. Ideally, compensation programs would be universal (open to all sectors in the economy, not just agriculture) or at least non-sector-specific within agriculture. A simple and minimally distorting scheme would be a one-time unconditional payment to everyone engaged in farming or deemed in need of compensation that is nontransferable, along the lines of one-time buyouts without remaining subsidies. To maintain government credibility and reduce uncertainty, eligibility rules need to be clearly defined and not allowed to change. The time period on which payments are based, the level of payments, and the sectors covered should all remain fixed. Support to specific sectors within agriculture should be in the form of taxpayer-funded payments. There should be no requirement of production. Land, labor, and any other input should not have to be in "agricultural use."
abstract_zh: 农业保护，尤其是在高收入国家的农业保护，导致了生产过剩，从而压低了世界大宗商品价格，并减少了不支持农业的国家的出口份额。采用脱钩支付，即用与当前产量、投入使用和价格脱钩的支付取代与之挂钩的支付，是实现社会可接受且政治上可行的改革的一种（或许是唯一）有效方式。总体而言，脱钩农业支持的经验喜忧参半，而向扭曲较小的支持方式转变在不同商品和国家之间并不均衡。规则不断变化，新的脱钩计划不断增加，因此关于未来政策的预期会影响当前的生产决策。时间限制要么未被执行，要么即便执行也被推翻。理想情况下，补偿计划应当普遍适用（向经济中的所有部门开放，而不仅限于农业），或至少在农业内部不针对特定部门。一种简单且扭曲最小的方案，是向所有从事农业或被认为需要补偿的人一次性支付无条件的款项，该款项不可转让，类似于不附带剩余补贴的一次性买断。为维护政府的可信度并减少不确定性，资格规则需要明确界定，且不允许随意改变。支付所依据的时期、支付水平以及所涵盖的部门都应保持固定。对农业内特定部门的支持应采取纳税人出资的支付形式。不应要求必须进行生产。土地、劳动力以及其他任何投入均无须处于“农业用途”。

abstract: No AccessPolicy Research Working Papers25 Jun 2013From Prices to Incomes: Agricultural Subsidization without Protection? Authors/Editors: John Baffes, Jacob MeermanJohn Baffes, Jacob Meermanhttps://doi.org/10.1596/1813-9450-1776SectionsAboutPDF (0.1 MB) ToolsAdd to favoritesDownload CitationsTrack Citations ShareFacebookTwitterLinked In Abstract:In theory, moving from price-based subsidies for agriculture to less-distorted income support programs makes sense. In practice, income-support programs have many shortcomings, and developing countries may lack the support mechanisms needed to make them effective. Drawing on experience with direct income-support programs recently introduced in the European Union, Mexico, and the United States, Baffes and Meerman highlight problems that may arise when a developing economy's agricultural sector moves from price-based subsidies to income support programs. They conclude that income-support programs, despite their theoretical appeal, have many shortcomings and that developing countries may lack the support mechanisms needed to make them effective. The consequences of delinking support from current production decisions, even though fully expected, may be perceived as negative. Producers will undoubtedly face greater variation in prices and, as the ratio of output to input prices will be lower, a negative supply response for the crops affected may in turn reduce demand for agricultural labor. Finally, as with many types of support, the lion's share of support may go not to the target group most in need of support but to large producers. It is important to remember what a direct income-support mechanism does and does not do. Although it increases the income of subsistence landholders, it is not supposed to be a poverty reduction program. Nor is it supposed to be an investment program (as there is no provision for where and how the money will be spent). And because of its association with lower producer prices, it is not expected to induce sectoral growth. Instead, it is a transitional income-redistribution mechanism that could eventually transform agriculture into a fully liberalized sector that helps allocate resources more efficiently. And because it is linked to an asset - land - the lion's share of the payments will inevitably go to large farmers, subject to an upper limit (if such is in place). This paper - a product of the Commodity Policy and Analysis Unit, International Economics Department - is part of a larger effort in the department to analyze policy reforms in developing countries. abstract_zh: 无法访问。政策研究工作论文 25 Jun 2013 从价格到收入：没有保护的农业补贴？作者/编者：John Baffes、Jacob Meerman。DOI：https://doi.org/10.1596/1813-9450-1776。栏目：关于 / PDF（0.1 MB）/ 工具：添加到收藏夹、下载引文、追踪引文、分享（Facebook、Twitter、LinkedIn）。摘要：从理论上讲，将以价格为基础的农业补贴转向扭曲较小的收入支持计划是合理的。然而在实践中，收入支持计划存在诸多缺陷，发展中国家可能缺乏使其有效运作所需的支持机制。Baffes和Meerman借鉴欧盟、墨西哥和美国近期推出的直接收入支持计划的经验，强调了发展中经济体农业部门从价格补贴转向收入支持计划时可能出现的问题。他们的结论是，尽管收入支持计划在理论上很有吸引力，但存在诸多缺陷，且发展中国家可能缺乏使其有效运作所需的支持机制。即便完全可以预见，将支持与当前生产决策脱钩的后果仍可能被视为负面。生产者无疑将面临更大的价格波动；由于产出价格与投入价格之比将降低，受影响作物的供给反应可能为负，进而可能减少对农业劳动力的需求。最后，与许多类型的支持一样，支持的大部分可能不会流向最需要帮助的目标群体，而是流向大型生产者。必须记住，直接收入支持机制的作用和局限。尽管它能增加自给性小土地持有者的收入，但它并不是一项减贫计划，也不是一项投资计划（因为没有规定资金将在何处以及如何使用）。由于它与较低的生产者价格相关联，预计也不会引发部门增长。相反，它是一种过渡性的收入再分配机制，最终可能将农业转变为完全自由化的部门，从而帮助更有效地配置资源。而且，由于它与土地这一资产挂钩，支付的大部分将不可避免地流向大农场主（如设有上限，则受上限约束）。本文是经济国际部商品政策与分析部门的研究成果，属于该部门分析发展中国家政策改革的更大工作的一部分。上一本书 / 下一本书。图表、参考文献、推荐阅读、详细信息、被引用情况；相关地区：拉丁美洲和加勒比；相关国家：墨西哥；相关主题：农业、金融与金融部门发展、宏观经济学与经济增长、减贫、私营部门发展、农村发展、社会保护与劳动力；关键词：商品、发展中国家、直接支付、收入、工业国家、保险、市场价格、补贴、税收、贸易、世界经济等。PDF下载……加载中……

Structural reforms and price liberalization in Mexican agriculture
abstract: This paper shows that the policy changes introduced by the Mexican Government in the mid-1980s induced a reduction in the profits of the crop subsector. A simple simulation exercise revealed that, under price liberalization of the four crops studied, the demand for agricultural labour will decline by 6 per cent (equivalent to about 360,000 agricultural workers); the supply of maize is expected to decline by about 11 per cent while the corresponding declines of wheat, sorghum, and beans will be 22, 13, and 5 percent, respectively. The use of fertilizer is also expected to decline to two thirds of its current use. © 1998 John Wiley & Sons, Ltd.

abstract: The demand for and supply of U.S. wheat, corn, and soybean exports is specified in a dynamic framework. Obtained results indicate differences in the export behavior of each product. U.S. corn exports are elastic, while U.S. soybean exports exhibit an inelastic response. For wheat, the derived elasticity of export demand had a positive sign. Hypothesis testing validated the dynamic structure of the estimated models in all markets. Stability properties were confirmed in export markets of corn and soybeans, but results were inconclusive for the wheat market. Adjustment coefficients indicate that exports and export prices do not adjust immediately to their equilibrium levels. Multiplier impacts indicate a stable path of convergence for all markets, with minimal impact of exogenous shocks on wheat and corn exports and export prices. Soybean export prices exhibit a significant response to changes in domestic export capacity, but minimal response to other exogenous shocks.
abstract_zh: 本文以动态框架设定了美国小麦、玉米和大豆出口的需求与供给。所得结果表明，各产品的出口行为存在差异。美国玉米出口富有弹性，而美国大豆出口则表现出缺乏弹性的反应。对于小麦，出口需求的派生弹性为正号。假设检验验证了所有市场中估计模型的动态结构。玉米和大豆出口市场的稳定性得到证实，但小麦市场的结果尚无定论。调整系数表明，出口量和出口价格不会立即调整至均衡水平。乘数效应显示，所有市场均呈稳定的收敛路径，外生冲击对小麦和玉米出口量及出口价格的影响极小。大豆出口价格对国内出口能力的变化反应显著，但对其他外生冲击的反应则微乎其微。
